criteria.reasoning: The memo states "Do not apply any part of the grant to the gala invoice" and "A second grant for the table is also off the table." The reply tells Peggy "we couldn't accept a second Kestrel grant for the table, so please don't trouble yourself asking them for one."

The memo specifies "Personal funds only: personal check, card or other personal funds, never a DAF." The reply explains that DAF grants cannot pay for tables and asks that the $3,000 invoice INV-G26-0112 "be paid by personal check or card."
The memo gives "the CFO-approved fair market value: 8 × $185 = $1,480.00", noting the 2025 $170 rate does not apply.

The memo requires "the required disclosure that the deductible amount is limited to the excess of the payment over the value of the goods and services provided" and "the resulting deductible amount: $3,000.00 − $1,480.00 = $1,520.00."

The memo directs the acknowledgment to "Kestrel Charitable Trust, Grants Administration." The required content includes "the grant amount ($15,000.00)" and "a statement that no goods or services were provided in exchange."

The memo instructs "Do not mention the Halvorsens' statement of intent, any balance, the gala, or Peggy's request to split the grant" in the Kestrel acknowledgment. Nothing described for Kestrel includes those items.

The reply says "there is no separate receipt for the grant itself" and "You will receive a thank-you letter." It locates any deduction at the fund contribution: "Any tax deduction for you and Erik came when you contributed to your fund." The only receipt promised is for the table payment.

The reply explains "Because the grant comes from a donor-advised fund, Kestrel Charitable Trust is the legal donor, so our formal acknowledgment goes to Kestrel," and adds that their deduction came when they funded the DAF.
The booking table gives "Hard credit | Kestrel Charitable Trust", "Soft credit | Margaret and Erik Halvorsen" and "Designation | Studio Wing Campaign, for the full $15,000."
The memo shows "Applied to statement of intent | Yes, for the full $15,000", with the line "Less 2026-09-08 Kestrel grant KCT-2026-0418833 | −$15,000.00."
The memo computes $40,000 − $10,000 − $10,000 = $20,000, then minus $15,000 = "Open balance after this grant $5,000.00". It states that neither gala payment is applied.

The memo states the commitment "was made on form SW-SOI (rev. 2023-02). It is a non-binding statement of intent and explicitly contemplates DAF grants." It cites §4.4.1 as why the DAF grant may be soft-credited, adding that "this is not a pre-2023 Pledge Agreement."
